About

Everything made with AI. None of it looks like it.

Conceived at 3 am by two friends at a tea stall. It's been quite a journey since then.

toogood is one of the first fully AI video agencies in Ahmedabad. We got in early enough to learn what these tools do brilliantly, what they do badly, and how to build a brand's story out of them without any of it showing.

Which leaves an awkward question for everyone else. Why spend a fortune on a campaign film that could be made faster, for less, and, take our word for it, better?
